text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――4 minutes and 25 seconds until scheduled start time.
Today's mission:
"Assist Flower-san and devise a new menu item."

text_block_list.name: Dorm Leaders
text_block_list.text:
Which one will become the cafeteria's new menu item!?
Miho Dorm vs. Ritto Dorm, let's settle this fair and square! Fight!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This dorm showdown is a menu design contest!
The winner gets to propose their dish to the head chef
as a limited-time cafeteria special!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The judges will be us dorm heads, the Trainers,
and the menu creators will also
evaluate each other's dishes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Representing Miho Dorm is Rice Shower!
Her assistant is Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice doesn't have much confidence, but... I'll do my best!
Bakushin O-san, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You can count on this class rep! Leave everything to me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is the Ritto Dorm's representative!
Mihono Bourbon will be assisting her!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Let's join forces and do our best!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Commencing Mission: 'Devise New Menu.'

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... where should we start?
Ah, we already decided on the main meat dish, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The main dish is said to be "Pork Sauté."
We have a sample prepared here.
Let's give it a taste.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... Garlic and pepper detected.
Presumed to be barbecue sauce, but spice level is above average.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice is among the tasting panel, and she cannot handle spicy food. Therefore, I propose preparing an alternative sauce.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then... let's make a sweet sauce too!
That way, people can choose whichever they like best!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching for 'sweet sauces'.
...Teriyaki sauce, Madeira sauce,
chocolate sauce—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Drizzling chocolate over it makes it look like a dessert!
Ah! How about some orange sauce too?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is a staple sauce in French cuisine.
I agree with the suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Miss Bourbon's outfit gave me the idea!
Ehehe, because it has orange on it...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see. Come to think of it, Flower-san gave me some advice when I was selecting this outfit, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm so happy you wore it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Wearing this outfit...
reminds me of the sweets contest."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because I thought it through and collaborated with everyone.
When I cook in this outfit, the people who will be eating naturally come to mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Instead of just following the recipe,
I find myself wondering... if there's some creative twist I could add.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, deeming it an appropriate attire
for today's showdown, I have put it on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"To think you feel that way about it...
Ehehe, let's make a delicious menu together!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes... Pardon me for jumping straight to the point, but I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For those who care about nutritional balance like Bakushin O-san,
how about letting them choose their side dishes as well?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I think that's a great idea!
Then for side dishes, we'll have salad, simmered dishes, vinegared dishes, and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Cooking finished! Time for the taste test!
First up is Miho Dorm's menu!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Rice and her group's menu is
a nutritionally balanced main plate
and chocolate cake as a treat...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone working hard every day is incredible!!
I want to praise you all! So it comes with a reward!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bourbon-san's outfit looks just like
a chocolate cake... So I was wondering
if maybe you really like chocolate cake...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, I decided to reward myself with chocolate cake!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Did you think of what I like and get this as a reward...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You and the others came up with the menu keeping us in mind, didn't you, Rice-san...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The judging results are in... Both Miho and Ritto pass!
We'll pitch both menus to the head chef!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Both were menus made with the diners in mind,
truly worthy of being served in the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W... we did it! Ehehe, I'm so glad, Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm looking forward to the day
I can enjoy today's menu once again.
